content:
### Pool evaporation rate and gallons lost

- A specific pool evaporation rate is not stated.
- A specific number of gallons lost is not stated.
- Recommendation: Use a pool cover to reduce water loss through evaporation.

### Pool leak checks

Check for leaks in:

- Hose bib
- Pool auto-refill device
- Pool pump
- Outdoor water line

title: Be Cool With Your Pool | Arizona Water Facts
content:
| Requested information | Details |
|---|---|
| Pool evaporation rate | In Phoenix and Tucson, the average evaporation rate is approximately **6 feet per year**. |
| Gallons lost | The average pool evaporates its entire contents—**16,000 gallons**—each year. |
| Pool leak checks | **Meter the water that refills the pool**; a sharp increase may indicate a leak. The page also links to **“How To Tell If Your Pool Is Leaking - the Bucket Test Video.”** |
| Per capita water use figures | **Not stated on the page.** |
| Who publishes this page | The page is titled **“Be Cool With Your Pool | Arizona Water Facts.”** A specific publishing organization is **not stated on the page**. |
description: The average pool evaporates its entire contents (16,000 gallons) each year! Get tips to efficiently manage your pool and reduce your water-use.
